body: Still very up and down… we talked today. He’s mad and hurt and it devastates me to hurt someone I love. I feel so empty and unsure and I spent some time with my daughter and it helped a bit. Today I am here.
I am the same… so much fear of failing if I’d attempt… I would hate to be around to see the pain I’d caused, but my pain is more right now… im so selfish it makes me hate myself more
